My parents, both PhDs, always encouraged me to excel in it. While I sometimes struggle with literature or history, math gives me confidence and clarity.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes! Despite loving it, the pressure of getting every answer right can make my heart race. My high neuroticism score means I worry a lot about making mistakes. But once I start solving, the anxiety fades into excitement and focus.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes! I used an AI tutor recently. It explained concepts clearly and gave me practice problems instantly. It helped me overcome my anxiety by breaking things down slowly. The personalized feedback made me feel more confident tackling harder topics.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding new axes (principal components) that capture most variance. First, standardize your data.
